node.title: Re: How to Rename files in multiple directories with a Perl script using an array of hashes.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Glob is not my friend.

Yes, it often isn't - see [id://1206848]. In this case I would recommend [mod://Path::Class] instead, its [mod://Path::Class::Dir] ->children and ->recurse methods are useful in listing files, and its [mod://Path::Class::File] ->move_to uses [doc://File::Copy] internally.
